QuestInfo.name: Fresh Milk
QuestInfo.0: Anna wanted Alpha and Beta to get her omelet ingredients. They set out to get some Fresh Milk from the Dairy Cow.
QuestInfo.1: You were not able to get a single drop of milk from the hungry Dairy Cow. Maybe you can get some milk if you fed it #bHay.#k Give the cow some hay.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta got some milk when they fed the Dairy Cow some hay.
